# SPL Systems

> SPL Systems builds high-performance digital infrastructure for ambitious enterprises: custom software, AI-powered platforms and automation for finance, real estate, government and education. Over 10 years of experience in digital transformation. Offices in Hyderabad, India (headquarters) and San Jose, USA.

## Pages

- [Home](https://splsystems.in/): Company overview, approach, expertise and FAQ.
- [Projects & Expertise](https://splsystems.in/projects): Selected projects (SheetSense, ZoningLens) and areas of expertise.
- [Contact](https://splsystems.in/contact): Offices, email, phone and a form to request a free consultation.

## Services

- Custom web applications and enterprise systems
- AI-powered platforms
- Mobile and cross-platform apps
- Automation tools and workflow systems

## Industries

- Finance
- Real Estate
- Government
- Education

## Projects

- SheetSense: reads and recognizes numbers and characters on paper sheets and barcode IDs.
- ZoningLens: a multimodal search experience for real estate listings.
